shellCommands.command: git ls-files && cat package.json && cat CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && cat package.json | grep -E '"(version|main|module|exports)"' ; ls build/esm | head -30; grep -rn "lang" build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/utils | head -50; ls ../i18n; cat ../i18n/package.json | grep version

ls build/esm/i18n; cat build/esm/i18n/*.d.ts; grep -rln "configure\|getConfig\|subscribeConfigure" build/esm/index.d.ts build/esm/components/utils/*.d.ts; grep -rn "export" build/esm/index.d.ts | head -40

grep -n '"./i18n"' -A4 package.json; cat build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null; ls build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/; grep -n "interface SegmentedRadioGroupProps" -A12 build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/*.d.ts | head -20

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/main.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n","")
s=s.replace("import { App } from './App';","import { App } from './App';\nimport { LangProvider } from './i18n/LangProvider';")
s=s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme="light">','<LangProvider theme="light">').replace('</ThemeProvider>','</LangProvider>')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5; ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|testing-library|happy"

sed -e "s#/home/sandbox/workspace/src#../src#g" /tmp/i18ncheck/check.test.tsx > ./tmp-i18n-check.test.tsx && timeout 100 npx vitest run tmp-i18n-check.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | head -40; rm -f tmp-i18n-check.test.tsx
